fix: Before 00:05Z, append to CONTEXT.md the R20-A3 (e) text verbatim as a dated line: 'R8 COVERAGE (PC19-11): coordinject files (exp75/76a/79a and CI stacks) and secFT files (exp72/76d/79d and the N2 file) are submitted under the 11:14Z/11:16Z aggressive-mode directive; SEC also has the Q2 yes, N2 the 18:19:11Z yes; the user never named coordinject; all are public-only and never finals without a user re-tick (Q3 open for SEC; the CI caveat applies); not a precedent.' A later CI submit pushes its read (L ~9.7-10.5 h) past the 12:00Z W2b CI branch, so the hold is a last resort. It is not a planned delay.
realistic_gain: 0 on the score (public or private). The gain is rule hygiene and crash safety: an honest disclosure record before the first submit of an unnamed post-R8 mechanism, and a resume point a new session can trust. The cost is one file append. If the fallback hold fires, the CI read slips by ~3 h.
